description: Implementation of the ModuleConfigurationService interface, managing integration modules, parsing JSON configurations, and caching module data within the 'shopizer' e-commerce project.

classes.name: ModuleConfigurationServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing business logic for module configuration management, extending generic service implementation, with methods for retrieving modules and parsing configurations.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves an IntegrationModule by its unique code from the database.

methods.name: getIntegrationModules
methods.description: Fetches and caches a list of IntegrationModule objects for a specified module, parsing nested JSON data into Java objects.
